title: Fulbright Foreign Student Program
eligibility: International graduate students, young professionals, and artists
salary: Fully Funded (Tuition, living stipend, health insurance, airfare)
qualification: Bachelor's degree or equivalent academic qualification
description: Enables graduate students, young professionals, and artists from abroad to study and conduct research in the United States at eligible universities.

title: Software Engineering Internship 2025
eligibility: Students currently enrolled in a Bachelor's, Master's, or PhD degree program
qualification: Pursuing a degree in Computer Science or related technical field
description: Interns work on core Google products and technical infrastructure, collaborating directly with full-time software engineers on real-world projects.

title: World Bank Treasury Summer Internship Program
eligibility: Full-time graduate students in business, finance, economics, or related fields
qualification: Enrolled in a Master's or PhD degree program
description: Offers practical experience in asset management, capital markets, financial risk management, and financial modeling at an international development bank.

title: Software Development Engineer (Entry Level)
eligibility: Recent graduates or early-career professionals with 0-2 years experience
qualification: Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or technical equivalent
description: Entry-level position developing cloud technologies, AI integrations, and cross-platform applications across Microsoft products.

title: Forward Learning Program for Young Professionals
eligibility: Early-career professionals with less than 5 years of work experience
qualification: Post-secondary education or equivalent work experience
description: A free interactive online learning program focused on practical business skills, digital problem solving, communication, and leadership capabilities.

title: DAAD Master's Scholarships for International Students
eligibility: Graduates with a Bachelor's degree from developing and industrializing countries
deadline: Varies by degree program (July – November annually)
salary: Fully Funded (Monthly allowance of €934 + insurance & travel allowance)
description: Supports foreign graduates to complete a Master's degree at a state or state-recognized German university.
